import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Fill ans with a pattern based on indices
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; ++j) {
                ans[i][j] = (i * j) % 3;
            }
        }

        // Compute binomial coefficients
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; ++b) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        int nInt = (int) n;

        long[][] blockarea = new long[nInt][nInt];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[nInt + 1][nInt + 1];
        long[][] revarea = new long[nInt + 1][nInt + 1];

        // Compute blockarea
        for (int a = 0; a < nInt; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < nInt; ++b) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int)(R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int)(R - 1)];
            }
        }

        // Compute totalarea
        for (int a = 0; a <= nInt; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= nInt; ++b) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1];
                totalarea[a][b] += blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        // Compute revarea
        for (int a = 0; a <= nInt; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= nInt; ++b) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[nInt][nInt] - totalarea[nInt - a][nInt] - totalarea[nInt][nInt - b] + totalarea[nInt - a][nInt - b];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 2);

        // Initialize DP maps
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[(int) nInt + 1][(int) nInt + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[(int) nInt + 1][(int) nInt + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= nInt; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= nInt; ++j) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        // Set initial states
        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long totalArea = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n];
        long m1 = (-best + totalArea) / 2;
        long m2 = totalArea - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= nInt; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < nInt; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int) n][y + 1] - totalarea[(int) x][y + 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(area2, dp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * nInt - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[(int) n - x][(int) n - (y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(area2, bp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == nInt) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= nInt; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][nInt] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(c, dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * nInt - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[n - x][nInt] - totalarea[n - x - 1][nInt];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey();
                        if (c + newarea > m2) continue;
                        long count = entry.getValue();
                        bp[x + 1][y].put(c + newarea, bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c + newarea, 0L) + count);
                    }
                }
                // Clear maps
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * nInt - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        // Final calculation
        for (int x = 0; x <= nInt; ++x) {
            int y = (int)(d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > nInt) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long val1 = bp[nInt - x][nInt - y].getOrDefault(m1 - c, 0L);
                long val2 = (m1 != m2) ? bp[nInt - x][nInt - y].getOrDefault(m2 - c, 0L) : 0L;
                bestfreq += freq * val1;
                bestfreq += freq * val2;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
